build.label: Repair candidate build 1
build.provenance: Root confirmed the tested UI files are identical to the final commit/build. Final spatial/pickup-policy amendments were not tested in this fresh UI tab. No mid-session reload.

method: Fresh own Chrome tab through Play → Popular Kukatpally. Only visible controls, native key presses, AX and original browser screenshots; no hidden state, teleport, engine stepping or automation of driving. Exclusive browser lease and owned input lock. Explicit desktop viewport overrides used for the two reported failure sizes, then reset.

visibleLabels: Base pay 104 coins + tip · Pickup approach is untimed.

steps: Set 594×466 before selecting Kukatpally. Inspect offer and full minimap, then click minimap lower-left at viewport coordinate 521,181.
Resize same pending offer to 594×522. Inspect separation and click minimap lower-left at 478,241.
checks.observed: Offer lies in the left lower region at both sizes; the complete minimap remains visible to the right. Both coordinate clicks open City map. Accept and Another remain visible below offer details.

steps: Read the same pending offer at both viewport sizes.
Cancel area selection via Escape and later map-picker Cancel → Stay here.
checks.observed: Approach, pickup-to-customer distance and post-collection window are separately labeled. Both cancellation paths restore BhookmarK → Home in Balaji Nagar with the same 262 m approach, 986 m delivery route, 186 s delivery window, 104 base coins and Accept/Another actions.

steps: Accept the offer normally, open Pause and click Replay tips.
Inspect tutorial at 594×522, then resize to 594×466.
checks.observed: Tutorial appears as a compact bottom-left banner at both sizes. It does not stretch from top to bottom; the roadster, nearby driving scene, route and minimap remain visible. Screenshot text: Drive with W and steer with A / D. Follow the orange line on the road and the minimap to the kitchen.

steps: From open map and initial Close map focus, press Shift+Tab; focus becomes Deliver from here. Press Tab; focus returns to Close map.
Press Tab to Zoom in, Return, Tab to Zoom out, Space. Map remains active and no background controls appear in AX.
Escape closes map and restores minimap focus. Reopen with M; P closes map and restores minimap focus without a Paused dialog.
At 594×522, minimap click opens map and actual Close map button closes it.

After accepting the order, M opens map. Shift+Tab wraps from Close to Centre on my car, excluding the unavailable Deliver from here action. Tab returns to Close. M closes map and restores the previous Pause/help button focus.
checks.observed: Keyboard focus stayed inside the map in both pending and accepted order states. Background HUD controls are absent from the open-map accessibility tree. Escape, P, M and actual Close each dismissed map without stacking Pause. Focus returned to the appropriate previous control.

checks.name: Area-picker cancellation and keyboard ownership
steps: Pending offer: P → Change area → Escape while search field focused.
Repeat P → Change area → Pick a spot on the map → Cancel → Stay here.
checks.observed: Escape returned to the exact offer. Map Cancel returned to the area picker with search focused; Stay here restored the same offer without relocation.

checks.name: Pause and cleanup
steps: After tutorial/map checks, press P and verify Paused dialog.
Read own-tab warn/error console; reset viewport; close completed fresh UI tab and all five temporary evidence form tabs.
checks.observed: Paused dialog showed Resume, Change area, Back to the road, Settings, Replay tips and Reset progress. No warn/error entries. No driving input was held. Previous ECIL/LB Nagar/Kompally handoffs were re-marked without resuming.

limitations: This is desktop UI acceptance at two explicitly tested sizes, not physical touch-device or screen-reader testing.
Return and Space were exercised on the zoom controls and remained inside the map; exact numeric zoom changes were not instrumented.
No driving, collection, handover, final spatial amendments, traffic behavior or exact shop-order reconstruction was validated.
Replay tips was invoked through the visible menu; it restarts the game tutorial.
No claim of complete gameplay acceptance follows from these UI checks.
